new_findings.text: The farming guaranteed-yield rule fires on the FIRST harvest of a patch, not the second. In InteractUI_crops.as, harvest() is declared at :586 and increments the harvest counter at :592 (`StatsManager.changeStat(this.startingIndex + 2,1);`) BEFORE testing it at :607 (`if(StatsManager.getStat(this.startingIndex + 2) == 1 || ...)`). StatsManager.changeStat's PLAYERSTAT branch is `setPlayerStats(id,getPlayerStats(id) + val)` - it adds - and getStat returns 0 for an unset stat, and no code anywhere else writes startingIndex + 2. A virgin patch therefore reads 0, becomes 1 on the first harvest, and satisfies `== 1` on that same first harvest.
